query: SELECT workspace_member.workspace_id AS "workspace_id!", role_resource_permissions_type.permission_id AS "permission_id!", role_resource_permissions_exclude.resource_id AS "resource_id?" FROM workspace_member INNER JOIN role_resource_permissions_type ON role_resource_permissions_type.role_id = workspace_member.role_id AND role_resource_permissions_type.permission_type = 'exclude' LEFT JOIN role_resource_permissions_exclude ON role_resource_permissions_exclude.role_id = workspace_member.role_id WHERE workspace_member.identity_id = $1;
